notes.title: Update to V2.
notes.content:
More enemies, faster, added dodge functionality, graphical improvements, an ally who will give you a big helping hand, a new map for arena mode and even more bonuses. 
Pressing left or right and double tap on space bar will make you dodge on left or right side to avoid enemy or projectiles.
If a special enemy is inside the radius of the healling pillar, healling is locked, kill the enemy first to survive.
Some turrets are now protected with a blue shield that reduce the damages of your projectiles, red shield makes the enemy turret invincible.
Big graphic update, added a new map in arena mode that requires faster moves and best skills to survive the fight.
